name: @corbits/task-dispatch-tools
description: The dispatch_task tool as an @intx/agent tool bundle: an agent (e.g. Myra) hands an outcome off to another agent — either one it already named from a prior list_agents/create_agent call, or the platform's own planner picking or creating one — gated behind Interchange's native per-invocation approval, reusing @corbits/task-planner's existing dispatch machinery rather than reimplementing task spawning
